name: 1pcs Multicolor Gyro Bowl 360 Rotate Baby Spill-Proof Feeding Cute Baby Gyro Bowl Universal Food-grade PP Dishes New Tableware
description:
1pcs Multicolor Gyro Bowl 360 Rotate Baby Spill-Proof Feeding Cute Baby Gyro Bowl Universal Food-grade PP Dishes New Tableware 
Aren't you tired of your kids spilling food, so you must clean again and again? Aren't you tired when your kids being naggy with their food because they simply lose interest? This bowl is the solution! 
This bowl looks like Planet Saturn with anti spill design, in which it can rotate 360 degrees to keep dry food inside and avoid food spilling. Plus, we added three handles for easy carrying and lid to cover the food when not in use. 
Not only for food, you can use it for place your small office equipment such a clip, pin, needle or coins. Also, it makes an unique gift for your close ones! 
Material: food grade PP. 
Size:17*17*7cm.
